thread:
mia (Billing): Alert: nightly invoice run invoice_run_2026-03-24-01 shows several customer PDFs where the tax line is missing from the itemized section but the invoice total includes tax. Example: invoice 20260324-ORBIT-21 shows total 1,250.00 and summary tax 150.00, but no 'Sales Tax' line in items.

jon (Billing Eng): I pulled renderer logs. The renderer silently skips tax lines when tax_lookup returns an error object instead of null. Repro'd locally with a simulated tax-service 502.

kevin (SRE): Tax-service had a 20s blip from 01:02:13Z-01:02:33Z with 502s while a deploy rolled. The billing job window overlaps that.

jon (Billing Eng): code excerpt showing the bug: 

```
# render_lines.py
if tax_info and tax_info['code'] != 'EXEMPT':
    lines.append({'desc': tax_info['label'], 'amount': tax_total})
# but when tax_info is Error() we skip and never add fallback
```

We should add a fallback: if tax_total > 0 append a generic tax line using locale label.

ella (Accounting): GL import failures already flagged 4 invoices. Our tax liability report for that day is off. We need an export CSV with invoice_id, customer_id, tax_total, gross_total, original_pdf_url for reconciliation.

mia (Billing): Also noticed 2 customers received duplicate PDFs (same invoice_id) — one with tax line present and one without. Looks like a race where renderer retried after a transient tax lookup and produced a second artifact instead of replacing.

dave (RevenueOps): Duplicates are bad for collections; we risk double statements hitting AR. We should ensure the object-store write is atomic (put-if-absent) and mark older artifacts as superseded.

jon (Billing Eng): Proposed immediate fixes: 1) renderer fallback to include tax line when tax_total > 0; 2) make pdf write idempotent using object store conditional put; 3) one-off dedupe job to mark extras and keep canonical PDF; 4) backfill corrected PDFs for affected invoices. I'll open a hotfix PR.

kevin (SRE): Agree. I'll pause auto-retries on renderer for the next billing-window and schedule a dedupe maintenance window 2026-03-24 03:30-04:00 UTC. Also will rollback the tax-service deploy if we see more 502s.

jon (Billing Eng): Quick mitigation patch snippet: 

```
# add fallback
if tax_total > 0 and not tax_info:
    lines.append({'desc': locale_tax_label(tenant), 'amount': tax_total})
```

I'll include a metric counter renderer.tax_line_fallback so we can measure. PR shortly.

mia (Billing): I'll prepare customer notice template and gather affected invoice_ids. Please attach CSV to this thread when ready.

ella (Accounting): CSV fields needed: invoice_id, customer_id, net_total, tax_total, tax_missing_flag, original_pdf_url. We'll hold ledger posting until reconciled.

finance-bot: Automated alert: invoice_run_2026-03-24-01: 6 tax-line fallbacks required, 2 duplicate pdf artifacts detected, auto-requeues paused.

jon (Billing Eng): PR opened https://git.internal/r/redwood/billing/pulls/4302. Running tests and will deploy to staging in 20m. If green, hotfix to prod in ~1h.

kevin (SRE): Maintenance window created and calendar invites sent. I'll also run a cache warmup for tax-service before next run.

mia (Billing): thanks team. Once hotfix is live, run a dry re-render and attach CSV here. We'll only notify customers after dedupe and canonical PDF issuance. :white_check_mark:
